name: Chefchaouen to the Spanish Mosque
why: Out of the blue medina past the Ras el Ma spring and up a hillside path to a ruined mosque, for the sunset over the whole blue town.
dangers: Uneven path; carry a light for the way down.

points.name: Ras el Ma
points.note: The spring where the river leaves the medina.

points.name: Spanish Mosque
points.note: A small whitewashed mosque on the hill above the town.
